candidate: Cakile maritima–Alternaria brassicicola NSW coastal metapopulation, 1998–2003

scientific_anchor.focal_endpoint: one-census-ahead Alternaria occurrence at each fixed potential beach population
scientific_anchor.published_design: 61 potential Cakile/Alternaria populations defined from identifiable beach habitats in three NSW coastal subregions; censused approximately every 6 weeks for 5 years from July 1998, 42 censuses total
scientific_anchor.process_boundary: Pathogen occurrence is host-dependent and influenced by local persistence plus nonlocal dispersal among beach populations. The prospective world family will represent alternative distance-limited internal dispersal scales plus a full-support world; no world will be called the true historical route and no claim is made that immigration from outside the 61-beach universe is biologically impossible.

response_summary.role: FORBIDDEN until all response-blind gates and outcome-access freeze are complete

interpopulation_distances.name: Cakile_Interpop_Dists.xls
interpopulation_distances.role: response-independent distance/registry resource; may be opened now

distance_workbook_contract.trailing_blank_rule: rows and columns that are completely blank across the used sheet rectangle may be trimmed; no nonblank row/column may be dropped
distance_workbook_contract.accepted_matrix_layout: after blank-edge trimming, each nonempty sheet must be a labeled square distance matrix: top row excluding corner contains node labels, left column excluding corner contains the same labels in the same order, numeric body is finite symmetric with zero diagonal

allowed_geometry_modes.three_subregion_matrices: exactly three disjoint accepted matrices whose sizes sort to [15,23,23], matching the prospectively published MB/DU/CT metapopulation sizes; no cross-subregion distance is invented

distance_workbook_contract.node_union_rule: matrix node labels must be unique and nonempty; in either allowed mode the union must contain exactly 61 labels
distance_workbook_contract.subregion_graph_rule: if the workbook resolves as three matrices, each matrix is retained as a separate metapopulation graph for all later Layer-A/Layer-B calculations; it is not stitched into a 61-node graph
distance_workbook_contract.distance_units: use workbook numeric units as published; do not rescale or infer biological dispersal distance

future_response_contract_boundary.provisional_split_rule: freeze exact census indices only after response-independent workbook/documentation confirms the 42-census physical organization; do not inspect population outcomes to choose the split
future_response_contract_boundary.learner_boundary: same frozen strong random-forest learner in baseline and augmented arms; only unchanged 10-column Layer B may differ
